text: ESP Maker 2.7 is out: the look editor is docked on the right (no more pop-up on every click), a shorter Look column with icons, and light-mode fixes
New: EVENTS > Gearin' Up (Burning Springs) - the Sturdy Scrap Metal barrels, the scrap dumpster (forging machine) and the deathclaw cage
ESP Maker 2.6 is out: Vortex support - your mod goes through Vortex, so Vortex no longer drops it from the game's mod list
ESP Maker 2.5.5 is out: new categories Nuked flora (Stable Flux) and Flux plants outside blast zones, and the Mod Manager installs mods from downloaded archives
ESP Maker 2.5.2 is out: the Razorgrain glow (Bright) now shows in game
Loot spots: the Lucky Strike dig sites have their own row now instead of being part of Treasure map mounds - it selects together with EVENTS > Lucky Strike > Dig sites
Treasure map mounds now also show the Lucky Strike dig sites (Excavator's, Prospector's and Miner's maps)
ESP Maker 2.5.1 is out: Bright on Razorgrain gives a Fill glow instead of broken mirror shards
Pickup range now also offered for the Fuel Canister (Gleaming Depths raid)

kinds.description: Robots and turrets. Robots are built from parts; every part glows, the beam rises from the torso.
Scorched and Scorchbeasts. Their outfits are Scorched-only; clothing they share with players is left out so you don't glow yourself.
Super Mutants and Behemoths, with their armor pieces.
Feral ghouls, glowing ones and their outfits.
Mothman, Snallygaster, Grafton Monster, Flatwoods Monster and other cryptids.
Bloatflies, bloodbugs, stingwings, radroaches, ants, crickets...
Mirelurks, hunters, kings, hermit crabs, radscorpions...
Animals that attack - wolves, yao guai, mole rats, mongrels, attack dogs...
Animals that don't attack - brahmin, radstags, chickens, rabbits, foxes, squirrels...

categories.name: Nuked flora (Stable Flux)
categories.description: Plants that grow only in nuke blast zones (Blast Berry, Geiger Blossom, Gamma Dogwood...). Harvesting them gives raw flux, made into Stable Flux at a chemistry station. The same entries as in Plants (all) - selecting one here selects it there too.
categories.note: blast zone = a nuked model (florarad...) or the nuked twin of an ordinary plant on one model (Mutfruit / Fission Fruit); not the thistle: its model is every ordinary thistle (user 2026-11-19)

categories.name: Flux plants outside blast zones
categories.description: Plants outside nuke blast zones whose harvest can also give raw flux, made into Stable Flux at a chemistry station (Flash Fern, Afterwind Vine, Lightning Flux from the Skyline Valley storms...). The same entries as in Plants (all) - selecting one here selects it there too.
categories.note: flux plants that are not blast-zone ones (Skyline Valley storms...), user 2026-11-19

de.Plants that grow only in nuke blast zone: Pflanzen, die nur in Atombomben-Einschlagzonen wachsen (Blast Berry, Geiger Blossom, Gamma Dogwood...). Ihre Ernte gibt rohen Flux, der an einer Chemiestation zu stabilem Flux wird. Dieselben Einträge wie in Plants (all) - wählst du einen hier, ist er dort auch gewählt.
de.Plants outside nuke blast zones whose ha: Pflanzen außerhalb von Atombomben-Einschlagzonen, deren Ernte ebenfalls rohen Flux geben kann, der an einer Chemiestation zu stabilem Flux wird (Flash Fern, Afterwind Vine, Lightning Flux aus den Stürmen im Skyline Valley...). Dieselben Einträge wie in Plants (all) - wählst du einen hier, ist er dort auch gewählt.

es.Plants that grow only in nuke blast zone: Plantas que solo crecen en zonas de impacto nuclear (Blast Berry, Geiger Blossom, Gamma Dogwood...). Al recolectarlas obtienes flujo en bruto, que se convierte en flujo estable en una mesa de química. Las mismas entradas que en Plants (all): si eliges una aquí, también se elige allí.
es.Flux plants outside blast zones: Plantas de flujo fuera de zonas nucleares
es.Plants outside nuke blast zones whose ha: Plantas fuera de las zonas de impacto nuclear que también pueden dar flujo en bruto, que se convierte en flujo estable en una mesa de química (Flash Fern, Afterwind Vine, Lightning Flux de las tormentas de Skyline Valley...). Las mismas entradas que en Plants (all): si eliges una aquí, también se elige allí.

esmx.Plants that grow only in nuke blast zone: Plantas que solo crecen en zonas de impacto nuclear (Blast Berry, Geiger Blossom, Gamma Dogwood...). Al cosecharlas obtienes flujo en bruto, que se convierte en flujo estable en una estación de química. Las mismas entradas que en Plants (all): si eliges una aquí, también se elige allá.
esmx.Flux plants outside blast zones: Plantas de flujo fuera de zonas nucleares
esmx.Plants outside nuke blast zones whose ha: Plantas fuera de las zonas de impacto nuclear que también pueden dar flujo en bruto, que se convierte en flujo estable en una estación de química (Flash Fern, Afterwind Vine, Lightning Flux de las tormentas de Skyline Valley...). Las mismas entradas que en Plants (all): si eliges una aquí, también se elige allá.

fr.Plants that grow only in nuke blast zone: Plantes qui ne poussent que dans les zones d'impact nucléaire (Blast Berry, Geiger Blossom, Gamma Dogwood...). Les récolter donne du flux brut, transformé en flux stable à un établi de chimie. Les mêmes entrées que dans Plants (all) - en choisir une ici la choisit aussi là-bas.
fr.Flux plants outside blast zones: Plantes à flux hors zones d'impact
fr.Plants outside nuke blast zones whose ha: Plantes hors des zones d'impact nucléaire dont la récolte peut aussi donner du flux brut, transformé en flux stable à un établi de chimie (Flash Fern, Afterwind Vine, Lightning Flux des tempêtes de Skyline Valley...). Les mêmes entrées que dans Plants (all) - en choisir une ici la choisit aussi là-bas.

it.Plants that grow only in nuke blast zone: Piante che crescono solo nelle zone d'impatto nucleare (Blast Berry, Geiger Blossom, Gamma Dogwood...). Raccoglierle dà flusso grezzo, trasformato in flusso stabile a un banco di chimica. Le stesse voci di Plants (all): selezionarne una qui la seleziona anche lì.
it.Flux plants outside blast zones: Piante di flusso fuori dalle zone d'impatto
it.Plants outside nuke blast zones whose ha: Piante fuori dalle zone d'impatto nucleare la cui raccolta può dare anche flusso grezzo, trasformato in flusso stabile a un banco di chimica (Flash Fern, Afterwind Vine, Lightning Flux delle tempeste di Skyline Valley...). Le stesse voci di Plants (all): selezionarne una qui la seleziona anche lì.

ja.Nuked flora (Stable Flux): 核汚染植物 (安定フラックス)
ja.Plants that grow only in nuke blast zone: 核爆発ゾーンにだけ生える植物 (Blast Berry、Geiger Blossom、Gamma Dogwood など)。収穫すると未加工のフラックスが手に入り、ケミストリーステーションで安定フラックスにできます。Plants (all) と同じ項目です - ここで選ぶとそちらでも選ばれます。
ja.Flux plants outside blast zones: 核爆発ゾーン外のフラックス植物
ja.Plants outside nuke blast zones whose ha: 核爆発ゾーンの外で、収穫すると未加工のフラックスも手に入る植物 (Flash Fern、Afterwind Vine、Skyline Valley の嵐の Lightning Flux など)。ケミストリーステーションで安定フラックスにできます。Plants (all) と同じ項目です - ここで選ぶとそちらでも選ばれます。

ko.Plants that grow only in nuke blast zone: 핵 폭발 지역에서만 자라는 식물 (Blast Berry, Geiger Blossom, Gamma Dogwood...). 수확하면 원료 플럭스를 얻고, 화학 작업대에서 안정 플럭스로 만듭니다. Plants (all)과 같은 항목입니다 - 여기서 선택하면 그곳에서도 선택됩니다.
ko.Flux plants outside blast zones: 핵 폭발 지역 밖의 플럭스 식물
ko.Plants outside nuke blast zones whose ha: 핵 폭발 지역 밖에서 수확해도 원료 플럭스를 얻을 수 있는 식물 (Flash Fern, Afterwind Vine, Skyline Valley 폭풍의 Lightning Flux...). 화학 작업대에서 안정 플럭스로 만듭니다. Plants (all)과 같은 항목입니다 - 여기서 선택하면 그곳에서도 선택됩니다.

pl.Plants that grow only in nuke blast zone: Rośliny rosnące tylko w strefach wybuchu atomowego (Blast Berry, Geiger Blossom, Gamma Dogwood...). Ich zbiór daje surowy strumień, z którego przy stole chemicznym powstaje stabilny strumień. Te same pozycje co w Plants (all) - zaznaczenie tutaj zaznacza je i tam.
pl.Plants outside nuke blast zones whose ha: Rośliny poza strefami wybuchu atomowego, których zbiór też może dać surowy strumień, z którego przy stole chemicznym powstaje stabilny strumień (Flash Fern, Afterwind Vine, Lightning Flux z burz w Skyline Valley...). Te same pozycje co w Plants (all) - zaznaczenie tutaj zaznacza je i tam.

ptbr.Plants that grow only in nuke blast zone: Plantas que só crescem em zonas de explosão nuclear (Blast Berry, Geiger Blossom, Gamma Dogwood...). Colhê-las dá fluxo bruto, transformado em fluxo estável numa estação de química. As mesmas entradas de Plants (all) - selecionar uma aqui também a seleciona lá.
ptbr.Flux plants outside blast zones: Plantas de fluxo fora das zonas nucleares
ptbr.Plants outside nuke blast zones whose ha: Plantas fora das zonas de explosão nuclear cuja colheita também pode dar fluxo bruto, transformado em fluxo estável numa estação de química (Flash Fern, Afterwind Vine, Lightning Flux das tempestades de Skyline Valley...). As mesmas entradas de Plants (all) - selecionar uma aqui também a seleciona lá.

ru.Plants that grow only in nuke blast zone: Растения, растущие только в зонах ядерного удара (Blast Berry, Geiger Blossom, Gamma Dogwood...). Их сбор даёт сырой флюс, из которого на химической станции делают стабильный флюс. Те же пункты, что и в Plants (all) - выбор здесь выбирает их и там.
ru.Flux plants outside blast zones: Растения с флюсом вне зон удара
ru.Plants outside nuke blast zones whose ha: Растения вне зон ядерного удара, сбор которых тоже может дать сырой флюс, из которого на химической станции делают стабильный флюс (Flash Fern, Afterwind Vine, Lightning Flux из бурь Skyline Valley...). Те же пункты, что и в Plants (all) - выбор здесь выбирает их и там.
